item.title: Acme Corp: Senior Backend Engineer
item.description:
Acme Corp is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to join our fully distributed engineering team. You will own services written in Python with Django on top of Postgres.

Requirements: deep knowledge of Django, experience operating Postgres at scale.
